bot.title: Assistant Bot Lumi
bot.welcome: Hello! 👋 I am your assistant for your LED screen project.
bot.questionType: To guide you better, would you like to go for a rental solution or a final purchase?
bot.promptRentalPeriod: To provide you with an accurate estimate, please indicate the start and end dates of your event, as well as the planned usage times. 🗓️
bot.promptEnvironment: What will be the installation environment of the screen?
bot.dimensions: What dimensions would you like for your screen? Use the form below.
bot.distance: At what distance will your audience mainly watch the screen?
bot.pitches: Noted! Given this distance, here are the adapted resolutions:
bot.searching: I am looking for the best products for you... 🔍
bot.recommendation: Here is the product I recommend for this project!
bot.quantity: Excellent choice! For your screen of {width}m × {height}m, how many screens of this type would you like?
bot.delivery: Noted! For delivery, in which city would you like to be delivered?
bot.promptInstallation: Would you like to include professional installation?
bot.photo: Do you have a photo of where the screen will be installed? This would help us a lot to prepare the project.
bot.company: What is the name of your company?
bot.email: Thank you. What is your email address?
bot.phone: Noted. What is your phone number?
bot.address: Perfect. What is the full address of the event/installation?
bot.terms: Last step before generating your PDF estimation. You must accept our General Terms and Conditions of Sale.
bot.errorQuote: An error occurred during the creation of your estimation. Please try again.
bot.errorValidation: We are unable to validate your information. The session will close.
bot.errorHelp:
It seems you are having difficulties. Would you like to contact an advisor directly?

📧 contact@pixiatech.com
📞 +33 7 71 59 31 66

bot.errorEmailInvalid: Oops! The email address entered does not seem valid. Could you check it so I can send you your estimation?
bot.errorPhoneInvalid: This phone number is not in the correct format. Please indicate a valid number (between 10 and 14 digits, with or without +).

bot.photoSuccess: Great photo, thank you! Last stretch for your estimation!
